description: #531 parity: 1D Burgers diffusion operator d2u/dx2 via centered 2nd-order stencil on periodic domain. Gaussian IC from MOL #531 advection Test 00 at pinned SHA.

tolerance.notes: Centered 2nd-deriv coefficients are simple rationals in dx; should be bit-identical across bindings to this tolerance.

fixtures.name: burgers_diffusion_periodic
fixtures.notes: 80-cell uniform grid on [0,2] with periodic BCs. Gaussian IC from MOL #531 Test 00: u(x)=(0.5/(0.2*sqrt(2*pi)))*exp(-(x-1)^2/(2*0.04)). Same grid and IC as advection goldens (esd-11y) for cross-operator consistency.
